licenseNote: Public domain (U.S. federal regulation). Summaries below are original, written for this application.
demonstrationSubsetDisclaimer: This is an illustrative subset for portfolio demonstration purposes, not full framework coverage.

controls.title: Designated qualified individual for information security
controls.summary: The vendor has a named individual responsible for its information security program covering customer NPI.
controls.validationGuidance: A named role/title is sufficient evidence; a specific person's name is not required.

controls.title: Written information security program (WISP)
controls.summary: A documented, risk-based information security program governs how customer NPI is protected.
controls.validationGuidance: Check the policy is dated and reviewed within the last 12 months, not a stale artifact.

controls.title: Periodic risk assessment
controls.summary: The vendor performs and documents periodic risk assessments covering the NPI it processes on the bank's behalf.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for a defined cadence and evidence the most recent assessment was acted upon, not filed away.

controls.title: Access controls for NPI
controls.summary: Access to systems containing NPI is restricted on a least-privilege, need-to-know basis.
controls.validationGuidance: Overlaps with FFIEC-8; a single access-control evidence excerpt commonly satisfies both.

controls.title: Encryption of NPI at rest and in transit
controls.summary: Customer NPI is encrypted both in transit and at rest using industry-standard algorithms.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for specific algorithm/key-length detail, not just 'we encrypt data' assertions.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.summary: MFA is required for any individual accessing systems containing customer NPI, including internal vendor staff.
controls.validationGuidance: The 2021 revision made MFA an explicit, largely non-negotiable requirement rather than a recommended practice.

controls.title: Secure disposal of NPI
controls.summary: NPI is securely disposed of when no longer needed for business purposes, with retention limited to legitimate need.
controls.validationGuidance: Overlaps with NIST 800-161 C-SCRM-12; check for a defined retention schedule, not just a destruction method.

controls.title: Change management for systems handling NPI
controls.summary: Changes to systems, applications, or infrastructure handling NPI follow a documented change-management process.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for separation of duties between change requester and approver.

controls.title: Incident response and breach notification
controls.summary: The vendor has a tested incident response plan with defined notification timelines to the bank for incidents involving NPI.
controls.validationGuidance: Notification timeline should be specific (e.g. 72 hours) - vague language is a common gap, same pattern as NIST 800-161 C-SCRM-6.

controls.title: Annual reporting to the board
controls.summary: The vendor's qualified individual reports on the information security program's status at least annually to an appropriate governing body.
controls.validationGuidance: This is a vendor-internal governance control - a summary attestation letter is typically the available evidence, not the full board report itself.
